map.HR 在新员工入职时，根据社保缴费记录与劳动合同推算累计工龄，确定当年法定年假档: When a new employee joins, HR estimates the cumulative service years from the social insurance contribution records and the labor contract, then determines the statutory annual leave tier for that year.
map.全年都在职才给满档天数；当年仅部分在职的，按当年剩余日历天数比例折算，可用年假折: The full tier of days is granted only when employed for the whole year; if employed for only part of the year, prorate by the calendar days remaining that year, which the annual leave proration tool handles.
map.司龄与工龄如何区分？: How Do Tenure with the Company and Years of Service Differ?
map.各分支机构参照《职工带薪年休假条例》同一年限计档标准，避免人工误判。: Each branch applies the same year-of-service tier standard with reference to the Regulations on Paid Annual Leave for Employees, avoiding manual misjudgment.
map.员工自助测算全年可休天数，结合累计工龄与当年在职月份估算可用额度。: Employees can estimate their own days off for the whole year, combining cumulative years of service with the months employed this year to estimate the available entitlement.
map.年假在线计算器，按工作年限与司龄估算法定年休假天数，支持累计与折算，辅助 HR: Online annual leave calculator that estimates the statutory leave days from years of service and tenure, supports accumulation and proration, and helps HR and employees schedule time off. Runs entirely in the front end.
map.当年中途入职怎么算？: How Is It Calculated for Someone Who Joins Mid-Year?
map.法定年假按累计工龄（含他司）计档，司龄通常只影响公司额外福利假，二者分开核算。: Statutory annual leave is tiered by cumulative years of service (including service with other employers), while tenure with the company usually only affects extra company benefit leave; the two are accounted separately.
